subject: Lane B model-store analysis + accelerated runtime state
body: Lane B analyzed D:\VERA\models before further training/eval. Current V10R2 lineage is separate from the older H07/latest-trained adapter lineage. V10R2 step1-v2, step4, and step12 adapters all have identical 496-tensor / 8,116,224-element BF16 LoRA topology; hashes are cb8d99af..., c3df08fe..., and 15df1dcd... respectively. The original bnb8-step1 and torchao8-step1 namespaces are empty failed/tombstone namespaces and must not be treated as adapters. D:\VERA\models\latest-trained\adapter is the older H07 r4 adapter hash 2b628e90... and is the source for the older full-merged HF/GGUF lineage; do not use it as a V10R2 parent. LATEST_TRAINED.txt and several utility scripts still hard-code obsolete C:\Vera paths; Lane B is treating those as provenance debt, not current location authority. Ollama blob/manifests are mixed historical state: current qwen3/qwen3-spm-review manifest refs are present and hash-consistent, older SmolLM3/Vera-v0.5 manifests reference missing blobs; one orphan blob filename sha256-339419171 does not match its content hash. Lane B isolated venv now has fla-core/flash-linear-attention 0.5.2 on Triton-Windows 3.8.0; Transformers reports flash-linear-attention available. No heavy FLA benchmark has run yet. Lane B additive runtime/eval harness tests are 7/7 green locally; current local base is Lane A head 2187271 before uncommitted Lane-B-only additions. Rows 4096-4191 and output prefix D:\VERA\models\adapters\v10r2-lane-b-accelerated-20261003 remain reserved for Lane B.
